# toFontWeight

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`FontWeightInput`](font-weight-input.md) to the [`FontWeight`](font-weight.md) value. A value that is already an enumeration value is returned unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toFontWeight(input: FontWeightToken | FontWeight): FontWeight
```
